title: Exam Orientation and How to Study

header.html: Exam overview, domain map and answer technique (all domains)
Know the exam format and the five domains with their weights; understand how adaptive testing works; use a repeatable method to answer every question
the official ISC2 CC exam outline (the outline that took effect on September 1, 2026) and the ISC2 adaptive testing page

html:
1The exam at a glance

Item Fact
Exam ISC2 CC, the entry-level cybersecurity exam from ISC2
Format Computerized Adaptive Testing (CAT)
Items 100 to 125; multiple choice and advanced item types
Time 2 hours at most
Passing grade 700 out of 1000 points
Languages English, Chinese, Japanese, German, Spanish
Testing At a Pearson testing center
Prerequisites None; basic IT knowledge is recommended and no work experience is required

The price, the validity of the credential and the yearly maintenance terms are not in the outline, so this course does not quote them. Check the official ISC2 pages before you book.

Exam tip

. The exam is for beginners, but it is wide. It asks for definitions and the best action, not for commands. Learn the vocabulary exactly.

2The five domains

Domain Weight Topics
1. Security Principles 24% CIA and AAA, risk management, governance, controls, ethics
2. Security Governance 17.3% GRC, business continuity and disaster recovery, awareness, metrics
3. Identity and Access Management (IAM) Concepts 20% Identity life cycle, logical access controls
4. Networking and Cloud Security Concepts 21.3% Network security, architecture, cloud security
5. Security Operations and Incident Response 17.3% Data security, operations, incident response, assets, testing
Exam tip

. Domain 1 is the largest (24%), then Domain 4 (21.3%) and Domain 3 (20%). The two smallest are both 17.3%.

3How adaptive testing works

Rule Fact
Item choice The next item depends on your earlier answers; each item aims for about a 50 percent chance of a correct answer, so expect every item to feel hard
Unscored items 25 of the items are pretest items that do not count; you cannot tell them apart
Minimum for a result At least 75 scored items plus the 25 pretest items, 100 in all
End of the exam It stops when the system is 95 percent confident that you are above or below the passing standard, or at 125 items, or when 2 hours are over
Review Item review is not permitted: an answer is final once you give it
Result Shown right after the exam; a failing candidate gets a level per domain (Below, Near or Above proficiency)
Retakes Wait 30 days after the first attempt, 60 after the second, 90 after the third; at most 4 attempts in 12 months
Exam tip

. You cannot go back. Read each item, decide, and move on. A long exam is not a bad sign: the system may need more items to be sure.

4What the 2026 outline changed

The outline that took effect on September 1, 2026 replaced the older one. It still has five domains, with new names and weights.

Before Now
Business continuity, disaster recovery and incident response was a domain (10%) Security Governance (17.3%); BC and DR sit under redundancy, and incident response moved into Domain 5
Access Controls Concepts Identity and Access Management Concepts, with the identity life cycle
Network Security Networking and Cloud Security Concepts, with cloud, zero trust and segmentation

AI security is built into all five domains: protecting training data and model integrity, AI-driven phishing, model drift as a recovery risk, bots and service accounts in the identity life cycle, AI in firewalls and SIEM tools, and the security of the AI workspace.

5How to answer every question

  1. Read the last line to see what is asked: a definition, a best action, a control type or a first step.
  2. Find the domain: principles, governance, access, network and cloud, or operations.
  3. Eliminate answers that are too technical, too late in the process, or that break a principle such as least privilege.
  4. When two answers seem right, pick the one that is preventive, simple and within policy.
  5. Never leave a blank; you cannot return.
Exam tip

. The best answer is often the first step, the least privilege or the answer that follows policy and escalates, not the most technical fix.

6A study plan

Phase Modules Goal
1 1 to 4 Principles: CIA, risk, governance, controls, ethics
2 5 to 6 Governance: GRC, continuity, awareness, metrics
3 7 to 8 Identity and access management
4 9 to 12 Networks, architecture and cloud
5 13 to 17 Data, operations, incident response, assets, testing
6 18 Exam technique and final review

7Exam Q&A

7.1 Practice questions (choose the best answer)

S1A candidate asks what score is needed to pass the ISC2 CC exam. Which statement is correct?

  • A70 percent of the questions answered correctly
  • B750 out of 1000 points on every exam attempt
  • C700 out of 1000 points on the adaptive exam
  • D800 out of 1000 points for the English version
Show the answer

Answer: C. The passing grade is 700 out of 1000 points.

S2During the adaptive exam, a candidate wants to go back to question 12 to change an answer. What is the rule?

  • AItem review is not permitted, so an answer is final
  • BCandidates can review all answers in the last ten minutes
  • CCandidates can flag two items and review them at the end
  • DCandidates can change any answer before the next break
Show the answer

Answer: A. The adaptive exam does not allow item review.

S3A candidate wonders how many scored items are needed for a pass or fail result. What is the minimum?

  • AAt least 50 scored items plus the 25 pretest items
  • BExactly 125 scored items with no pretest items
  • CAt least 75 scored items plus the 25 pretest items
  • DAt least 100 scored items plus 25 pretest items
Show the answer

Answer: C. A result needs at least 75 scored items and the 25 unscored pretest items, 100 in all.

S4Which domain carries the largest weight in the current outline?

  • ASecurity Principles, with 24 percent of the exam
  • BSecurity Governance, with the highest weight overall
  • CNetworking and Cloud Security Concepts, with 25 percent
  • DSecurity Operations and Incident Response, with 20 percent
Show the answer

Answer: A. Security Principles is the largest domain at 24 percent.

S5Compared with the older outline, where did incident response move in the 2026 outline?

  • AInto Domain 1, Security Principles, as a brand new topic
  • BInto Domain 3, Identity and Access Management Concepts
  • CInto Domain 5, Security Operations and Incident Response
  • DIt stayed in a standalone domain with ten percent
Show the answer

Answer: C. Incident response became a major part of Domain 5, and the standalone domain was replaced by Security Governance.

S6A candidate fails the first attempt. How long must the candidate wait before the second attempt?

  • A60 days after the first attempt
  • B90 days after the first attempt
  • C14 days after the first attempt
  • D30 days after the first attempt
Show the answer

Answer: D. The wait is 30 days after the first attempt, 60 after the second and 90 after the third.

7.2 Recall questions

R1How long is the exam?

Show the answer

Up to 2 hours.

R2How many items does the exam have?

Show the answer

100 to 125.

R3How many of the items are unscored?

Show the answer

25 pretest items.

R4What is the weight of Domain 4?

Show the answer

21.3 percent.

R5Can you review a previous answer?

Show the answer

No, item review is not permitted.

R6How many attempts are allowed in 12 months?

Show the answer

At most four.

8Quick Reference Card

Topic Key fact
Format adaptive, 100 to 125 items, 2 hours, 700 of 1000
Weights 24 / 17.3 / 20 / 21.3 / 17.3 percent
Adaptive rules 25 unscored, at least 75 scored, 95 percent confidence, no review
Retakes 30, 60, 90 days; four attempts in 12 months
2026 changes Security Governance added; IAM; cloud and zero trust; AI integrated
Method find the domain, eliminate, pick the preventive, policy-based answer
